data.text: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. You made room for me in distress; be gracious to me and hear my prayer.
data.titulo: In Peace I Will Lie Down and Sleep
data.subtitulo: For the music leader, with stringed instruments. A psalm of David.

data.text: You men, how long will you turn my honor to shame? How long will you love what is worthless and seek a lie? Selah.
Know that the LORD has set apart the faithful for himself; the LORD hears when I call to him.
Tremble, and do not sin. Reflect in your hearts as you lie on your beds, and be still. Selah.
Offer righteous sacrifices, and trust in the LORD.
Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Lift up the light of your face upon us, LORD.
You have put greater joy in my heart than theirs when their grain and new wine abound.
In peace I will both lie down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me dwell in safety.
